nuggets.text: Lucas Carneiro beat Louisville with a 48-yard field goal on the final play of the Rebels' opener.
Lucas Carneiro played soccer in high school and did not switch to placekicking until his junior year.
Lucas Carneiro hit a 56-yarder and the 47-yard game-winner as the Rebels beat Georgia in the Sugar Bowl.
Trinidad Chambliss won two Division II national titles at Ferris State before becoming the Rebels' quarterback.
Deuce Alexander scored on two catches of exactly 62 yards each against Louisville.
Pete Golding is the first former Delta State player ever named a Power 4 head coach.
Pete Golding's first game as a head coach was a College Football Playoff win over Tulane.
The Rebels became the first college football team to fly to a game as a group, back in 1937.
The Rebels' Hotty Toddy cheer first appeared in print in 1926 as "Heighty! Tighty!"
The Rebels bring a 12-game home winning streak into their home opener, tied for second among Power 4 teams.
